messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need a concrete canary/warmup plan for mixing FP8/INT8 lanes for customer X. TL;DR: avoid single-customer blast radius while validating quality drift on long-context prompts.

Jia: +1. We saw subtle top-p sampling shifts last week when FP8 was enabled for short prompts. Need to test long-tail generation too.

Owen: Proposal: shadow traffic (100%) to FP8 pipeline + sampled compare, then gradual traffic split with enforced quality gate. Canary config idea below.

Samir: How do we define the quality gate? Per-prompt perplexity is noisy for generation. Prefer n-gram overlap + BLEU-ish + a small set of golden prompts.

Marta: Agreed on golden prompts. Also add a small hallucination detector and a safety fallback that switches to INT8 for flagged requests.

Jia: Ops constraints: we can't double inference for all requests. Shadowing should be sampled across customers and prompt-length buckets. Maybe 1-2% overall but 10% for a few selected heavy customers.

Owen: Canary config sketch:
```
canary:
  shadow_sample: 0.02        # 2% global shadow
  focused_customers:
    - cust-id: CUST_X
      shadow_sample: 0.10    # 10% for targeted validation
  quality_checks:
    - golden_suite: /evals/quant_longctx.json
    - hallucination_detector: true
    - degrade_threshold: 0.02 # allowed quality drop
  fallback_policy:
    - on_flag: switch_to: INT8
    - on_rate_exceed: throttle_shadow: true
```

Samir: Nice. Two additional asks: 1) telemetry should track per-token divergence distribution (not just scalar), 2) expose per-endpoint override for customers that opt out.

Marta: 1) yes — histogram buckets with tail percentiles. 2) per-endpoint override is required for dedicated/private. We'll add an endpoint-level flag in the API.

Jia: For the golden prompt set, propose 120 prompts stratified by length and domain: short QA, code, multi-turn chat, long narrative. Keep small to iterate fast.

Owen: Also need an emergency rollback knob in runtime: killswitch to force INT8 and disable FP8 routing across regions. Low friction for SRE.

Samir: Can we reuse the existing rollout infra? It already supports canaries by region and percentage, but we need to wire in quality gates as autoscaling checks.

Marta: Yes reuse but add a new quality-check hook that receives shadow diffs and returns pass/fail. Keep decision fast (<60s).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary-hook-service v1.2 -> staging (started).

Jia: One more thing — document edge cases: long-context caching interactions: FP8 cache keys might need tag for precision so cached prefixes are compatible. If not, we risk corrupt KV reuse.

Owen: Good catch. We'll version KV serialization and include precision tag. Add a migration job to rewarm caches for canary cohorts.

Samir: I'll draft the runbook for rollback and telemetry dashboards (SLOs, divergence heatmaps, golden-suite pass rates).

Marta: Perfect. Next actions: Samir -> runbook, Jia -> golden suite, Owen -> canary config PR + runtime killswitch, me -> add precision tag to KV proto. Sync in 48h?

Jia: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

Owen: On it.

Samir: ETA 48h for runbook draft.

Marta: Thanks all.
